author: DEVANSHI MEHTA
description: On Sunday afternoon, a significant building collapse took place near Shiv Mandir in Satya Niketan, Moti Bagh. The Delhi Fire Services received a distress call around 1:33 pm, quickly sending out rescue crews. By 1:50 pm, they arrived on-site, where reports indicated that individuals might be trapped beneath debris. To address the emergency, teams specialized in Search and Rescue, Breathing Apparatus, and Water Bowser operations were promptly deployed.
title: Several trapped after building collapses in Delhi's Satya Niketan; rescue ops on

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The New York City Council is set to review the use of encrypted messaging platforms. Reports indicate that Mayor Mamdani's administration utilized a clandestine channel for influencer communications. A proposed bill aims to enhance transparency in city messaging campaigns by ensuring all paid influencer posts are clearly disclosed. This initiative addresses both compensated and voluntary social media creators.
title: Mayor Mamdani 'summoned' by NYC Council for his team using an encrypted messaging app

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A new bridge now spans the Denali National Park road after a landslide. This $230 million project reconnects the eastern and western road sections. Engineers built a 475-foot steel truss bridge over the unstable moving ground. Hikers and cyclists can now cross the bridge, while bus service resumes in 2027. This marks a long-term solution for accessing remote park areas.
title: Denali builds $230m bridge over moving landslide 5 years after road was cut

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 674-acre ranch on Colorado’s Pikes Peak was listed for $5.9 million as a potential development site, but Palmer Land Conservancy bought it for conservation instead. The Pinestone Ranch property connects Woodland Park with more than 100,000 acres of public land and could eventually support trails, wildlife habitat and public access as part of wider efforts to complete the Ring the Peak route.
title: Colorado ranch bought for conservation links to 100,000+ acres of public land

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Former India bowling coach Bharat Arun questions Mohammed Shami's current exclusion from the national team.  He believes the veteran pacer still possesses significant talent and durability for cricket.  Shami has not played for India since the March 2025 Champions Trophy tournament.  East Zone captain Ishan Kishan also notes Shami's strong motivation for a comeback.  The pacer recently played his 100th first-class match in the Duleep Trophy final.
title: ‘Shouldn’t have closed door on Shami’: Ex-India coach questions Agarkar-led selectors

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu urges software professionals to consider their future relevance. He believes artificial intelligence will competently produce a large fraction of software code. Vembu suggests AI's progress in mathematics offers clues for software development's direction. The key question remains how many humans will be needed in this evolving landscape. Software professionals must actively figure out how to stay relevant in the coming years.
title: 'All of us in software need to figure out how to stay relevant': Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: ‘Adjectives keep changing’: Kharge attacks PM Modi over ‘Naraz Fufa’ jibe at Cong

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Opening the innings alongside Abhimanyu Easwaran, Sooryavanshi gave East Zone a fiery start in the first session. The pair continued the good partnership they had built during the knockout matches and helped their team settle quickly.
title: 4, 6, 4! Sooryavanshi takes on Mohammed Siraj in Duleep Trophy final - Watch

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: India backs UN world map resolution but calls out inaccurate J&K depiction

author: TNN
description: A case was registered against seventeen individuals, including Shiv Sena leaders, following a hospital dispute.  The group allegedly entered the hospital and questioned doctors about a patient's treatment.  Hospital staff reported abuse and threats of damage to the facility.  The incident occurred after a Govinda troupe member sustained injuries during a Dahi Handi celebration.  CCTV footage of the altercation has been provided to the police for investigation.
title: Doctors 'abused', staffer slapped at Palghar hospital; Shiv Sena leader booked

author: SUGANDHA JHA
description: Jawaharlal Nehru University is currently facing a grave situation as ten students have accused a professor of sexual harassment. The internal complaints committee is probing these serious claims, which detail inappropriate actions and comments made by the professor during home visits. In light of this, more senior students have stepped forward with similar experiences.
title: Several students accuse JNU professor of sexual harassment

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A Wisconsin experiment studied forest communities exposed to high carbon dioxide and ozone. Elevated carbon dioxide significantly increased forest productivity and carbon storage over eleven years. Conversely, increased ozone levels reduced forest productivity and ecosystem carbon content. The combined effects showed carbon dioxide stimulating growth and ozone limiting it. These findings highlight forests' complex responses to atmospheric changes.
title: Extra CO2 boosted Wisconsin forest productivity 39%, but ozone cut the gain

title: 147 years after Hall Effect discovery, scientists find it works in-plane

title: 'Zero control of its border': Trump tears into Spain over Ceuta migrant crisis

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Torani, a company with a rich legacy of over a century, is unwavering in its commitment to a 'zero layoffs' policy. Under the guidance of CEO Melanie Dulbecco, the integration of AI is approached with careful consideration for employee job security. By prioritizing workforce well-being over mere profit margins, Torani ensures its long-term success, alongside sharing profits through bonuses and an employee stock ownership plan, enhancing overall trust and innovation.
title: This 101-year-old US firm never laid off staff, even as AI cuts millions of jobs

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In a crushing defeat, Pakistan's women faced a historic batting collapse against India in the Women's Asia Cup, recording their lowest T20I score. Despite this setback, mentor Wahab Riaz remains optimistic about the squad's future potential, citing necessary changes for upcoming tournaments. To move forward in the competition, Pakistan must secure a victory against Hong Kong.
title: India thrash Pakistan for 55, Wahab Riaz still calls them ‘best side’ in Asia Cup

author: P NAVEEN
description: 11 villagers died and three others were hospitalized after consuming suspected illicit liquor. The victims hailed from four villages in Sagar district, with deaths reported Saturday night. Authorities confirmed eight fatalities and three individuals receiving critical medical treatment. Medical teams have been deployed to monitor the situation and provide care. The administration urged anyone with symptoms to seek immediate medical screening.
title: MP: 11 dead, over 30 hospitalised after suspected toxic liquor consumption

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: Iran planning ‘multi-front’ attack on Israel with Hezbollah, Hamas, Houthis: Report

title: Egyptian TV presenter Sarah Khalifa among 12 sentenced to death in drugs case

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: At the age of forty-three, British-Nigerian entrepreneur Igho Ubiribo's life was cut short in Thailand due to complications following a cosmetic penile enlargement operation. The coroner's report attributes his death to a pulmonary embolism. Renowned for showcasing his opulent lifestyle and luxury items, his funeral attracted an array of mourners, including close relatives and well-known figures from the entertainment industry.
title: Influencer Igho Ubiribo passes away at 43 in Thailand

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Highly useful' but no breakthrough: What was discussed in Putin-US talks on Ukraine

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In Udupi, Krishna Janmashtami transformed into a grand affair, drawing thousands of devotees to partake in the festivities. A doppelgänger of Tamil actor Vijay stole the spotlight, capturing the fascination of onlookers. This surprise celebrity encounter offered a fresh twist to the traditional observances, showcasing the extent of Vijay's fame in Karnataka and leaving an indelible mark on the celebrations.
title: CM Vijay’s look-alike takes Udupi by storm during Krishna Janmashtami

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: The Master Plan 2047 for Delhi introduces an innovative approach to urban regeneration through property pooling, allowing residents to combine their plots. This initiative aims to revitalize aging neighborhoods into cohesive, well-designed communities complete with wider roads and enhanced civic features, such as sustainable water systems. Government housing and community societies are also part of the plan, ultimately transforming fragmented areas into modern residential hubs with superior amenities.
title: Delhi master plan 2047: Older colonies to get a new look; what could change for residents

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: 'Students tormented by BJP': Rahul backs MPSC paper leak protests in Maharashtra

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In early September, foreign portfolio investors pulled out Rs 7,443 crore from Indian equities after experiencing two months of net investments. This retreat was influenced by soaring crude oil prices and stable US bond yields, which dampened investor enthusiasm. Additionally, foreign entities maintained their selling spree in the Indian debt market. Future FPI movements will likely be determined by global factors such as bond yields and inflation statistics.
title: FPIs turn sellers again, pull out Rs 7,443 crore from Indian equities

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In a strategic maneuver amidst rising global tensions, the Netherlands has transferred part of its gold reserves to London, seeking more immediate access in times of crisis. The Dutch central bank cites London as a hub for the most liquid gold trading. This shift underscores a larger trend among central banks worldwide, which have been diversifying their gold holdings following the aftermath of the financial crisis.
title: Europe is moving its gold out of America; where is it headed

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a heart-wrenching reflection decades after the Pan Am Flight 73 hijacking in 1986, a survivor recounts the terror as she was ushered to the plane’s interior amid the turmoil. A heroic flight attendant named Sunshine enabled her escape down an emergency slide. Choosing to confront her fears, she pursued a life of travel, illustrating that healing is achieved by embracing life, not evading painful memories.
title: Pan Am Flight 73 survivor recalls escape through emergency exit

author: P NAVEEN
description: 42 skeletons unearthed at Kumhar Tekri in Ujjain await modern scientific analysis.  These remains, discovered nearly nine decades ago, present a significant archaeological puzzle.  Shell jewelry and urns were found among the skeletons, which date to around the 3rd century BC.  Archaeologists seek permission to excavate a nearby site with a large stupa for context.  Modern methods like DNA analysis and radiocarbon dating could clarify the ancient community's identity.
title: Frozen like Pompeii, Ujjain’s 42 twisted skeletons await answers

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Ian Nepomniachtchi has praised Hans Niemann as a “very good and formidable player” but said he does not like the American’s personality. In an exclusive interview with TimesofIndia.com, the Russian grandmaster reacted to Niemann’s recent call for FIDE to punish players over public accusations, saying the American “can’t stop playing the victim card” and comparing his image to Conor McGregor’s.
title: 'Like his chess, not personality': Russian GM on Niemann's 'FIDE must punish' remarks

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Mark Zuckerberg, along with Priscilla Chan, has recently made headlines by acquiring Strancally Castle in Ireland. This purchase adds to Zuckerberg's impressive collection of properties, which also features multiple homes in Palo Alto, two stunning lakefront estates at Lake Tahoe, and expansive land in Hawaii. His portfolio further includes a grand mansion in Washington, DC, and an elegant waterfront property in Miami.
title: Mark Zuckerberg owns 'Doomsday bunker' in Hawaii, waterfront mansion in Miami and more

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Two advocates filed police complaints against a CJP activist and her father.  These complaints allege objectionable remarks were made about Hindu deities online.  The activist has hit back, calling the demands illegal and unethical.  She stated that her father should not be sent to jail for such matters.  The advocates are seeking police action and further complaints against the duo.
title: 'Don't stoop so low': Activist reacts to complaint over remarks on Hindu deities

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In an unexpected move, Pakistan's cricket board has seized players' mobile phones ahead of a crucial Test match against England. While the rationale behind this decision remains undisclosed, it aligns with ICC regulations that prohibit phone usage in specific match zones to uphold integrity. This unprecedented step adds yet another chapter of intrigue to Pakistan's already chaotic tour.
title: Match fixing concerns? PCB takes Pakistan players’ phones into custody

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Russia’s No. 1 chess grandmaster Ian Nepomniachtchi has two tattoos. Both carry different stories. His left-arm full sleeve took eight sessions over eight months, with flights from Moscow to Munich to meet his tattoo artist. From a phoenix and a favourite quote to Greek mythology, chess pieces and the pain involved, Nepo opens up about the stories behind his ink.
title: 'Fed up': The story behind Russia No. 1 Ian Nepomniachtchi's tattoos

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In a dominating performance, India triumphed over Pakistan by seven wickets in the Women's Asia Cup 2026. The young spinners Shree Charani and Prema Rawat played pivotal roles in dismantling the Pakistan batting lineup, which mustered a mere 55 runs, their lowest in T20 history. Captain Harmanpreet Kaur celebrated a significant personal achievement, while Irfan Pathan humorously recalled his previous jibes after such a resounding victory.
title: ‘Aaj Sunday hai kya?’: Irfan Pathan trolls Pakistan after India’s crushing win

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Jharkhand minister Sudivya Kumar passed away unexpectedly due to a heart attack.  He held portfolios for tourism, arts, culture, sports, and youth affairs.  The Jharkhand Mukti Morcha expressed deep shock and grief over his untimely demise.  His contributions and service to the party and state will be remembered.  The party offered condolences to his bereaved family and colleagues.
title: Jharkhand tourism minister Sudivya Kumar dies of heart attack
